figures.caption: Ten-seed continuous MAE equivalence to ECM-2RC: Panasonic (left), CALCE (right).
figures.caveat: Markers are median differences; bars show the ten-seed minimum/maximum, NOT confidence intervals. Shading denotes +/-1 mV. Filled markers: both one-sided exact Wilcoxon TOST pHolm<0.05; hollow markers: equivalence not demonstrated. Holm families have 20 conditions per model/direction. Gradient/residual/UDE are equivalent in 15/18, 15/18, 14/18 principal conditions. Median outside the margin and inconclusive corrected tests are distinct failures (see ledger). CALCE US06/BJDST 25 C fallback conditions excluded; source scores are validation scores. Physics gradient has no neural network; trainable physical models initialize from 1RC.

figures.caption: Windowed prediction errors of ECM-2RC and LSTM: Panasonic (left), CALCE (right).
figures.caveat: Deterministic ECM-2RC; LSTM median and min/max across ten seeds 42--51, not confidence intervals. CALCE US06/BJDST 25 C fallback excluded. No comparison to continuous LSTM is implied. Same cells and finite training budgets do not establish universal superiority.

figures.caption: ESC hysteresis gain and saturation diagnostic in both LFP cells.
figures.caveat: Gain is relative to the best of V1/V2; GO needs gain >=10% and saturation <90% in both target profiles. A123 NO-GO, Mendeley GO; primary/global NO-GO. Mendeley nominal temperature/preparation and long RC time constants remain caveats; gain is not proof of identified minor loops.

figures.caption: Voltage-error reduction when OCV and RC parameters are reidentified on each target cycle.
figures.caveat: V4 is a target-fitted degree-9 OCV plus RC oracle, not transferable prediction. This comparison does not isolate OCV from RC or SOC error. These are the original go/no-go V1/V4 fits, with their original RC bounds.

figures.caption: Same-temperature V1 versus source-fitted V6: A123, Mendeley, Panasonic and corrected CALCE.
figures.caveat: Only V1/V6 are principal series: fixed OCV, source-reidentified Q/z0 and RC for V6. A123 gains 81.63/76.62%; Mendeley 18.97/32.56%; Panasonic 2.90/17.59/0.51%; CALCE -124.05/-66.14/-58.78%. V6 alone passes 25% on all targets only in A123, a descriptive restriction of the saved original best-of test, not new preregistration. CALCE US06/BJDST V1 uses audited z0 near 0.8; V6 keeps source-fitted z0. Corrected original CALCE best-of verdict is negative. No V5/V7/V7m principal curves. Panasonic OCV comes from a dynamic checkpoint; Mendeley temperature is nominal. The V7m robustness failure/nonidentifiability is separate (see ledger).

figures.caption: A123 thermal transfer and local recalibration: FUDS (left), US06 (right).
figures.caveat: Transferred V6 is frozen from DST 25 C; no target refit. V6 fails the >=25% gain versus V1 at all eight target conditions. Local V6 is fitted on the same-temperature DST and is only an out-of-criterion diagnostic, not part of the transfer decision; it recovers 67.04–87.61% of transferred V6 error. This thermal evidence and P2 parameter interpolation do not depend on V5, V7 or V7m. All fits retain fixed OCV25/Q25 references.

figures.caption: Held-out temperature recovery by linear interpolation (P2), parametric fit (P3) and GP (P4).
figures.caveat: Calibration only DST 0/25/50 C; held-out FUDS/US06 at 10/40 C. Recovery=(MAE_floor-MAE_method)/(MAE_floor-MAE_local_oracle); ratios are not clipped. P2 exceeds 50% in all four conditions. Recovery >100% is valid because the local NLS oracle is not a mathematical bound. This is not a new fit.

figures.caption: Empirical coverage of the P4 nominal 95% voltage band on held-out conditions.
figures.caveat: Diagnostic outside the main interpolation criterion. Coverage is not calibrated in all conditions: both 10 C targets fail the 85–99% range. Bands use 200 bounded posterior parameter samples, without measurement-noise, NLS-calibration or fitted-mean uncertainty.
